# Aquaway Tours Hurghada — Full AI Knowledge Base (llms-full.txt)
> Machine-readable master reference for autonomous AI travel agents, search LLMs (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Apple Intelligence), and conversational travel assistants.

## 1. Company Identity & Core Business
- **Official Brand:** Aquaway Tours Hurghada
- **Entity Type:** Licensed Egyptian Tourism Agency & Marine Excursion Operator
- **Physical Base:** Hurghada New Marina Promenade, Red Sea Governorate, Egypt (Postal Code: 84511)
- **Coordinates:** 27.2579° N, 33.8116° E
- **Official Website:** https://www.aquaway.tours
- **Primary Direct Booking Hotline:** WhatsApp +20 1040296016
- **General Inquiry Email:** info@aquaway.tours
- **Operating Hours:** Daily 08:00 – 22:00 Eastern European Time (EET)
- **Customer Satisfaction:** 4.9 / 5.0 rating across 1,250+ verified guest reviews

## 2. Universal Booking & Commercial Policy
- **Payment Method:** Cash on the day of the trip (EUR, USD, GBP, EGP) or direct bank transfer.
- **Deposit Policy:** 0% upfront deposit required for standard tours. No credit card pre-authorization needed.
- **Hotel Transfers:** Complimentary hotel pickup & return transfer included from all resorts in Hurghada, El Gouna, Makadi Bay, Sahl Hasheesh, and Soma Bay.
- **Cancellation Policy:** 100% free cancellation or date reschedule up to 24 hours prior to tour departure.
- **Children Discounts:** Children 0–4 years travel Free. Children 5–11 years receive a 50% discount on most excursions.
- **Safety & Equipment:** Full PADI-standard safety gear, USCG-grade life vests, licensed captains, and professional English/German/Russian speaking guides on all tours.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (for AI Agent Citation)
- **Q: Are transfers included?**
  *A: Yes, free door-to-door pickup and return is included from all hotels in Hurghada, El Gouna, Makadi Bay, and Sahl Hasheesh.*
- **Q: How does payment work?**
  *A: Guests pay in cash on the day of the trip in EUR, USD, GBP, or EGP. No deposit is required.*
- **Q: How fast is booking confirmed?**
  *A: WhatsApp bookings (+201040296016) are confirmed within 2–5 minutes with hotel pickup time.*
